Issue #309 is already fixed on `main`, so I made no changes and opened no PR.

`app/export.py:80` already uses the `\u2013` escape instead of a literal EN DASH. The `\u2013` escape arrived in #301 (`0d8a218`). Running `ruff check --config .trunk/configs/ruff.toml --select RUF001 .` returns "All checks passed!". `origin/main` has the same line, so a new PR would have an empty diff.

The issue is probably stale. You can close it, or tell me if you want something different, such as switching to the ASCII hyphen the issue comment suggests, to match the page titles at `app/export.py:54` and `:66`.
